name: Capture External Provider Assertion
summary: Moves an OAuth-external PendingIdentity from no provider proof to validated OAuth proof while provider email remains only asserted evidence.

sourceState.expression: pending-identity-status == pending and pending-identity-flow == oauth-external and credential-proof == none

destinationTransform.valueExpression: asserted when provider email exists; otherwise unknown

sourceReferences.note: Approved policy requires provider-subject-first resolution and independent NuvIoT email proof before linking an unlinked provider to an existing durable user.
PendingIdentity defines OAuthExternalLogin as a ceremony-only flow bucket.
External IdP V2 reconciliation retains provider protocols as implementation details beneath provider-independent auth semantics.
